measurement_policy: Assertions record deterministic Near You record-inspection fixtures over the shared place-scope contract and inspection binder. Narrow-screen default density is observed by rendering the fixture document at 390x844 and comparing stacked inspection rows and compressed record padding against the 1440x900 desktop render. No participant evaluation was run and no usability gain is claimed. Image binaries are not part of this proof.
image_policy: No image binaries are committed for this acceptance record.

rendered_reference.assertion: set scope or view, inspect, dismiss, open the explicit full record, return with Back, and continue from the restored collection state; observe narrow-screen default density at 390px

assertions.assertion: Default Near You cards no longer lead with linked titles and open geographic evidence
Title-sized inspect opens the Nearby record modal without leaving the selected place or topic
Geographic and why-here evidence stay optional inside inspection; the named full-record link keeps the destination
Strong, derived, and weak placement fixtures keep meaningful place roles; weak matches announce approximate certainty without adapter enums
Records without optional geographic enrichment render no empty evidence panel
Failed detail keeps the coherent summary and explicit record link
Escape, Close, Tab containment, and disappeared-trigger fallback keep keyboard disclosure operable

At a 390px viewport inspection fact rows stack, record padding compresses versus desktop, place role and basis stay visible, the inspect control remains usable, geographic evidence stays closed by default, and the surface does not introduce horizontal overflow
